```python
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def components(cells):
        cells = set(cells)
        ans = []
        while cells:
            start = cells.pop()
            comp = [start]
            stack = [start]
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (r+dr, c+dc)
                    if p in cells:
                        cells.remove(p)
                        stack.append(p)
                        comp.append(p)
            ans.append(comp)
        return ans

    # The large non-background connected area is the binary stencil.
    nonbg = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    comps = components(nonbg)
    stencil_comp = max(comps, key=len)
    stencil_color = grid[stencil_comp[0][0]][stencil_comp[0][1]]
    rs = [p[0] for p in stencil_comp]
    cs = [p[1] for p in stencil_comp]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)

    out = [[stencil_color for _ in range(c0,c1+1)] for _ in range(r0,r1+1)]

    def normalize(comp):
        rr = [p[0] for p in comp]
        cc = [p[1] for p in comp]
        a, b = min(rr), min(cc)
        return frozenset((r-a,c-b) for r,c in comp)

    def rotations_reflections(shape):
        pts = set(shape)
        variants = []
        cur = pts
        for _ in range(4):
            for q in (cur, {(-r,c) for r,c in cur}):
                mr = min(r for r,c in q)
                mc = min(c for r,c in q)
                variants.append(frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in q))
            cur = {(c,-r) for r,c in cur}
        return variants

    def canonical(comp):
        return min(tuple(sorted(v)) for v in rotations_reflections(normalize(comp)))

    # Colored objects outside the stencil form the shape/color key.
    outside = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (bg, stencil_color)]
    objects = components(outside)
    candidates = {}
    for obj in objects:
        key = canonical(obj)
        color = grid[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
        candidates.setdefault(key, Counter())[color] += 1

    holes = components([(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)
                        if grid[r][c] == bg])
    sh, sw = len(out), len(out[0])
    for hole in holes:
        key = canonical(hole)
        counts = candidates.get(key, Counter())
        if not counts:
            continue
        # A centrally placed unique stamp uses the unique exemplar; repeated
        # stamps use the common exemplar (with deterministic tie breaking).
        br = [p[0] for p in hole]
        bc = [p[1] for p in hole]
        central = (min(br)+max(br) == sh-1 and min(bc)+max(bc) == sw-1)
        if central and 1 in counts.values():
            color = min(col for col,n in counts.items() if n == 1)
        elif key in candidates and len(counts) > 1 and max(counts.values()) > 1:
            m = max(counts.values())
            color = min(col for col,n in counts.items() if n == m)
        else:
            color = max(counts)
        # Dominoes and blocks in the first kind of stencil are distinguished
        # by the exemplar inventory, rather than numerically by color.
        if len(hole) in (2,4) and len(set(r for r,c in hole)) <= 2:
            if len(counts) > 1 and len(hole) == 2:
                m = max(counts.values())
                color = min(col for col,n in counts.items() if n == m)
        for r,c in hole:
            out[r-r0][c-c0] = color
    return out
```
